MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard

2. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

3. When learning Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.

4. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

5. When learning Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.

6. When learning Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.

7. When learning Digital Video Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production.

8. When learning Audio Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production.

9. When learning Introduction to Media Technology, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Media Technology.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Media Technology.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Media Technology.

10. When learning Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio.

11. When learning Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.

12. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

13. When learning Photography, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Photography.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography.

14. When learning Pre - Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre - Production.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Pre - Production.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre - Production.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre - Production.

15. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Post- production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.

16. When learning Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Production.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Production.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Post- production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
